scripts.setup: python -m venv env && npm run install-deps && npm run setup-db
scripts.install-deps: npm run activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -e . && pip install flask-mail && npm ci
scripts.setup-db: npm run activate && python -c "import os; os.makedirs('var/uploads', exist_ok=True)" && sqlite3 var/insta485.sqlite3 ".read sql/schema.sql" && sqlite3 var/insta485.sqlite3 ".read sql/data.sql" && npm run copy-uploads
scripts.dev: npm run check-setup && concurrently "npm run webpack" "npm run flask"
scripts.activate-and-flask: node -e "require('child_process').spawn(process.platform==='win32'?'cmd':'sh',process.platform==='win32'?['/c','.\\env\\Scripts\\activate && flask --app insta485 --debug run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000']:['-c','source env/bin/activate && flask --app insta485 --debug run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'],{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.check-setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('env')||!fs.existsSync('node_modules')||!fs.existsSync('var/insta485.sqlite3')){console.log('\x1b[33mRunning setup...\x1b[0m'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run setup',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{console.log('\x1b[32mSetup complete ✓\x1b[0m')}"
